item.title: Week 11: Raiders at Broncos
item.description: Sun 11/22 · 4:25 PM ET | Line: DEN -10 · O/U 40.5 | Model DEN 80% vs. market 81% | Denver throws short to the right on 39% of passes, and Las Vegas allows +0.11 EPA per throw there, so the Raiders must keep those completions from turning into yards after the catch. Jaylen Waddle averages 3.5 yards of separation, and he will face a Las Vegas pass defense ranked 32nd. Our model puts Denver at 80%, a point off the market's 81%, with the passing matchup doing most of the work.
